# The national-statistics feed

Statistics Canada (Web Data Service).

The economy module's public-sector national-statistics pack (docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md): Statistics Canada's headline statistics by vector from its Web Data Service (Statistics Canada Open Licence): the consumer price index, unemployment, monthly GDP, population, housing starts and the overnight money market rate. Each series shows its latest value, the change on the period and on the year, and its history. Filled daily by the national-statistics feed into the worldlake lake; more vectors are a line each in the feed's YAML.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | Statistics Canada (https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/developers/wds) |
| Licence | [Statistics Canada Open Licence](https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/terms-conditions/open-licence): redistributable with attribution |
| Attribution | Source: Statistics Canada (Statistics Canada Open Licence). |
| Lake | `worldlake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | weekdays at 09:00 (local time) |
| Pull | `national_statistics.NationalStatisticsFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/national_statistics.py); 0.5 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run national-statistics --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run national-statistics                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/national-statistics/<date>/, load into worldlake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status national-statistics             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### statistics-series

Pack `national-statistics`, kind `statistics-series` (National statistic), table `statistics-series`, key `SERIES_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/national-statistics/<date>/statistics-series.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required | NSTAT-V and the Statistics Canada vector number. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The series' title in the feed's YAML, as NAME for search. |
| `VECTOR` | text | required | The Statistics Canada vector id (v and a number): one series of one table. |
| `TITLE` | text | required | The series' title in the feed's YAML. |
| `MEMBERS` | text | optional | The table's dimension members that make the series, as Statistics Canada names them (Canada;All-items). |
| `GEOGRAPHY` | text | optional | The series' first member: its geography. |
| `TABLE_ID` | id | optional | The Statistics Canada table number (18-10-0004-01). |
| `TABLE_TITLE` | text | optional | The table's title in the feed's YAML. |
| `TOPIC` | text | optional | The theme the feed's YAML gives the series (Prices, Labour, Output, Population, Housing, Money markets). |
| `FREQUENCY` | text | optional | How often the series is published (Statistics Canada's frequency code, or the feed's YAML when it says). |
| `UNIT` | text | required | What the value measures, from the feed's YAML (an index, %, CAD, persons, units). |
| `SCALE` | text | required | The scalar factor the values carry (units, thousands, millions). |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | The latest published value, in the unit and scale shown. |
| `LATEST_PERIOD` | date | required | The reference period of the latest value (its first day). |
| `PREVIOUS` | amount | optional | The value of the period before. |
| `PREVIOUS_PERIOD` | date | optional | The reference period of the previous value. |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | The latest value less the previous one. |
| `CHANGE_PCT` | rate | optional | The change on the period in per cent. |
| `YEAR_ON_YEAR_PCT` | rate | optional | The change on the same period a year before, in per cent; empty when the history is shorter. |
| `RELEASED` | timestamp | optional | When Statistics Canada released the latest value (Eastern time). |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required | The value by reference period, oldest first, over the feed's history-periods (PERIOD, VALUE). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"SERIES_ID": "NSTAT-V1", "NAME": "Population of Canada", "VECTOR": "v1", "TITLE": "Population of Canada", "MEMBERS": "Canada", "GEOGRAPHY": "Canada", "TABLE_ID": "17-10-0009-01", "TABLE_TITLE": "Population estimates, quarterly", "TOPIC": "Population", "FREQUENCY": "quarterly", "UNIT": "persons", "SCALE": "units", "LATEST": 41798407.0, "LATEST_PERIOD": "2026-07-01", "PREVIOUS": 41718064.0, "PREVIOUS_PERIOD": "2026-04-01", "CHANGE": 80343.0, "CHANGE_PCT": 0.1926, "YEAR_ON_YEAR_PCT": 0.4553, "RELEASED": "2026-09-23T08:30"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/economy/national-statistics/contracts/statistics-series.contract.yaml` ([national-statistics](../../docs/contracts/packs/national-statistics.md)).
